subject.title: Feature request: utilize codex reset from codexbar

question: Should CodexBar remain read-only for reset credits, or may it spend a finite reset credit through the authenticated private provider endpoint?
rationale: The repository vision requires sign-off for new auth-affecting features, current code intentionally removed the write path, and the repository owner has not authorized changing that boundary.

options.title: Remain read-only
options.body: Keep inventory and expiry visibility without consumption until OpenAI documents or explicitly approves the write contract.

options.title: Approve guarded consumption
options.body: Authorize a selected-account, explicit-confirmation action with transient raw-ID handling, unique request IDs, and post-consumption refresh and safety coverage.

recommendation.title: Remain read-only
recommendation.body: Keep inventory and expiry visibility without consumption until OpenAI documents or explicitly approves the write contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner established and reviewed the current read-only policy and is the clearest authority for changing it.
